question.problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,A-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
A-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}5-\lambda  & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & -1-\lambda  & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 4-\lambda  & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & -3 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

The characteristic equation is $det(A-\lambda I)=0.$ 

Since the determinant of a triangular (or diagonal) matrix is given by the product of the entries on the main diagonal, we obtain the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}5-\lambda  & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & -1-\lambda  & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 4-\lambda  & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & -3 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (5-\lambda )(-1-\lambda )(4-\lambda )(1-\lambda ) & =0 \\ (\lambda -5)(\lambda +1)(\lambda -4)(\lambda -1) & =0\end{aligned}
$$
